{{Quote|I have to give you credit. You've led me on quite a chase. But nobody gets away from Calo Nord in the end.|Calo Nord, to Revan|audio=NGLOBECALO02000.flac|<ref name="KotOR game" />}}
The '''Ambush on Tatooine''' was a confrontation that took place between the former [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and redeemed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Calo Nord]]. The ambush took place in the [[3956 BBY|final year]] of the [[Jedi Civil War]], outside of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Rakatan Ruins (Tatooine)|ruins]] in the [[Eastern Dune Sea]] of the desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The ambush resulted in Nord and his henchmen's [[Death/Legends|deaths]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Her companions are nothing to me, Calo&mdash;but I desire the young Jedi taken alive if at all possible.|Darth Malak to Calo Nord, about Bastila Shan|<ref name="KotOR game" />}}
In [[3956 BBY]], the final [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Jedi Civil War]],<ref name="KotOR CG" /> the former [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and amnesiac [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] assisted in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bastila Shan]]'s [[Rescue of Bastila Shan|escape]] from the [[Destruction of Taris|destruction]] of the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. The bounty hunter [[Calo Nord]], who attempted to halt Revan, Shan, and their companions' escape, managed to flee Taris and had a private audience with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malak]], the reigning Dark Lord. Nord informed Malak and the Sith [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Saul Karath]] of Shan's escape with Revan and the Republic [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Carth Onasi]]'s assistance. Karath and Malak hired Nord to locate and capture Shan, and kill her companions. Nord also revealed to Malak that Revan was still alive.<ref name="KotOR game" />

After traveling to the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], Revan was [[Jedi training/Legends|retrained]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] by the local [[Dantooine Jedi Enclave Council|Jedi Council]]. After Revan completed his training, he was tasked by the Council to find an ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] called the [[Star Forge]], which was under Darth Malak's control. Revan located a second Rakatan [[Star Map]] in a [[Canyon krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon's]] [[Rakatan Ruins (Tatooine)|cave]] in the [[Eastern Dune Sea]] on the desert world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. After Revan examined the Star Map, Nord, along with two [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] and two [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] henchmen, ambushed Revan and his companions.<ref name="KotOR game" />

==The ambush==
{{Quote|You got lucky on Taris; the Sith attack saved you from a quick and gruesome death. But I promise you, the Sith won't be getting in my way this time!''"<br />"''Hold on, Calo&hellip; maybe we can work out a deal here.''"<br />"''Sorry, I'm not in this for the credits. You're the only ones who've ever gotten away from me&mdash;I've got a rep to protect!|Calo Nord and Revan|<ref name="KotOR game" />}}
Nord gave Revan credit for evading him; however, Nord stated that no one could escape him in the end. When Revan asked Nord if they could work out a deal so as to avoid fighting, Nord told him that he was not in it for the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]; rather, he had a reputation to protect. Nord and his henchmen attacked Revan and his companions, but were ultimately defeated by the former Sith Lord and his allies.<ref name="KotOR game" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ambush on Tatooine first appeared in the [[2003]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]].<ref name="KotOR game" /> Should Canderous Ordo accompany Revan when Nord confronts the Jedi, Ordo will make note of the fact that Nord brought backup, and taunt the bounty hunter.<ref name="Quote">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', Full statement from [[Canderous Ordo]]: ''"I see you brought some back up, Calo. Realized we were a bit much to handle on your own, eh?"''</ref>

The planet on which Revan battles Nord is determined by the order in which the second of the five Star Maps that lead to the Star Forge's location is obtained. Nord could confront Revan on Tatooine, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] homeworld [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], or the Sith tombworld [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. On Kashyyyk, Nord is accompanied by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] loyal to the chieftan [[Chuundar]]. In the [[Hrakert Station]] on Manaan, Nord is flanked by two [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and on Korriban, Nord is backed up by two Sith students from Korriban's [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]].<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> Should Revan have encountered Nord in the [[Hrakert Station]] on Manaan, Nord explains to Revan how he managed to reach the underwater station.<ref name="Quote2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', Nord's response to Revan's question: ''"You underestimate me; there's other ways down here besides the Republic subs. A small vessel with the right weapons can blast a path right through those firaxian sharks. Once I got down to the ocean floor all I had to do was come here and wait. I knew you'd come back this way eventually."''</ref>

Also, the area in which the player encounters Nord determines what items are recovered from his remains. For example, the player will receive Nord's [[Mandalorian heavy blaster]]s if he is killed on Tatooine, but they won't be on his body if he is killed on Kashyyyk.
